soste.title: Charles V: a new wall and the Bastille (1356-1383)
Pont Neuf and the Grande Galerie (1578-1612)
Les Invalides and its golden dome (1670-1706)
The Commune: Tuileries and Hôtel de Ville burn (1871)

didascalie.title: The Louvre fortress
didascalie.line: A castle guards the wall where it meets the Seine.

didascalie.title: 50,000 Parisians
didascalie.line: Already one of the largest cities in Europe (estimate).

didascalie.title: ~120,000 people
didascalie.line: Estimate; Paris is the biggest city in Western Europe.

didascalie.title: Notre-Dame completed
didascalie.line: Almost two centuries after the first stone.

didascalie.title: The Charles V wall
didascalie.line: The Right Bank city doubles behind a new wall.

didascalie.title: Back to 200,000
didascalie.line: The city recovers after the Hundred Years War (estimate).

didascalie.title: A Renaissance Louvre
didascalie.line: The medieval castle starts to become a palace.

didascalie.title: Pont Neuf opens
didascalie.line: The first Paris bridge without houses on it.

didascalie.title: 450,000 people
didascalie.line: Estimate.

didascalie.title: Île Saint-Louis
didascalie.line: Two islets are joined and built over.

didascalie.title: The Louvre Colonnade
didascalie.line: A classical façade facing the city.

didascalie.title: Place Vendôme
didascalie.line: A royal square of matching façades.

didascalie.title: 550,000 Parisians
didascalie.line: Estimate.

didascalie.title: Place Louis XV
didascalie.line: Today Place de la Concorde.

didascalie.title: Sainte-Geneviève
didascalie.line: The church that will become the Panthéon.

didascalie.title: Houses cleared off the bridges
didascalie.line: Pont Notre-Dame and Pont au Change lose their houses.

didascalie.title: The Farmers-General wall
didascalie.line: A customs wall around the whole city.

didascalie.title: 547,756 Parisians
didascalie.line: First census.

didascalie.title: The Grand Châtelet is demolished
didascalie.line: The medieval fortress at the heart of the Right Bank.

didascalie.title: Canal de l'Ourcq
didascalie.line: Fresh water reaches La Villette.

didascalie.title: Canal Saint-Denis
didascalie.line: The canal is completed (1821).

didascalie.title: Canal Saint-Martin
didascalie.line: A canal brings water and barges into Paris.

didascalie.title: The Arc is finished
didascalie.line: Thirty years after the first stone.

didascalie.title: The Thiers wall
didascalie.line: A 33 km fortification around Paris.

didascalie.title: Over 1 million
didascalie.line: 1,053,897 Parisians.

didascalie.title: The New Louvre
didascalie.line: The Louvre finally joins the Tuileries.

didascalie.title: The Commune
didascalie.line: The Tuileries and the Hôtel de Ville are set on fire.

didascalie.title: Avenue de l'Opéra
didascalie.line: Cut straight from the Louvre to the Opéra.

didascalie.title: A new Hôtel de Ville
didascalie.line: Rebuilt on the same site.

didascalie.title: Eiffel Tower opens
didascalie.line: 300 m: the tallest structure in the world.

didascalie.title: Pont de Bercy
didascalie.line: Widened 5.5 m to carry the Métro.

didascalie.title: 2.9 million Parisians
didascalie.line: The all-time peak.

didascalie.title: Boulevard Haussmann
didascalie.line: Finished 69 years after it began.

didascalie.title: 2,725,374 Parisians
didascalie.line: The first census after the war.

didascalie.title: 2,850,189 Parisians
didascalie.line: Census.

didascalie.title: 2,590,771 Parisians
didascalie.line: Families leave for the suburbs.

didascalie.title: Tour Montparnasse
didascalie.line: 210 m: a tower Paris will never repeat inside the city.

didascalie.title: Pont Charles-de-Gaulle
didascalie.line: Built between 1993 and 1996.

didascalie.title: 2,125,246 Parisians
didascalie.line: The smallest population in a century.

didascalie.title: Notre-Dame burns
didascalie.line: The spire and the roof are lost.

didascalie.title: Notre-Dame reopens
didascalie.line: The spire is back.

didascalie.title: Eiffel Tower
didascalie.line: Built in 26 months for the World Fair; meant to stand 20 years.

didascalie.title: 836 years of Paris
didascalie.line: From an island city to 2 million people.
